name: buildpane
description: Turns build, test and lint output from tsc, cargo, go, pytest, jest, gradle and more into a live pane of errors by file, and hands Claude the diagnostics instead of the raw log.

condense.title: Condense what Claude reads
condense.description: Replace the raw output in the tool result Claude reads with the parsed errors, warning counts and failed tests. The transcript keeps the raw output.

warnings.title: Warnings Claude reads
warnings.description: count: Claude reads how many warnings each file has. list: Claude reads every warning.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane
autoOpen.description: failure: when a run fails. always: when a run starts. never: only on /buildpane.

compactRow.title: Compact transcript row
compactRow.description: Draw a condensed run in the transcript as a verdict and its first errors instead of the raw output.
